question: A closed cylindrical tank with a height of 1 m and a base diameter of 140 cm must be constructed from a metal sheet. For the same, how many m² of the sheet are required? [Use π = 22/7]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a closed cylinder, Total Surface Area = 2πr(r + h)

Radius (r) = 140 ÷ 2 = 70 cm = 0.7 m, Height (h) = 1 m

Area = 2 × (22/7) × 0.7 × (0.7 + 1)

Area = 44 × 0.1 × 1.7 = 7.48

**∴ The correct answer is 7.48 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the closed cylindrical tank (h) = 1 m

Base diameter (d) = 140 cm = 1.4 m

⇒ Radius (r) = 1.4 ÷ 2 = 0.7 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b746c7f16ed21a75126f007fdc3fb294cb150d3f8843e7dbf7b2196b9872a0a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a closed cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 0.7 × (0.7 + 1)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 44 × 0.1 × 1.7

⇒ Total Surface Area = 4.4 × 1.7 = 7.48 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 7.48 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

The area of the curved sides excluding the top and bottom circular bases. Formula: CSA = 2πrh.

Open vs Closed Cylinder

A closed cylinder includes both bases where TSA = 2πr(r + h), whereas an open cylinder has no top and its area is calculated as 2πrh + πr².

Volume of a Cylinder

The total space occupied by the cylinder. Formula: Volume = πr²h.
